de.notes: Include English seeds — many German users search in English. Compound nouns like 'haushaltsbuch' must appear whole; Apple can't assemble them from parts across fields.

es.notes: Accents matter — autocomplete treats 'ahorro' and 'ahorró' as different queries.

jp.notes: Japanese listings join name and tagline with '・', which the toolkit treats as an app-name signal.
